headline: Infrastructure-first AI-engineering practitioner who builds the plumbing — contract-driven pipelines, supply-chain-hardened CI, and multi-repo agent orchestration — that makes agentic software compound instead of drift.
positioningSummary: Center of gravity is polyrepo AI-agent orchestration and the engineering discipline around it: contract-first system design, empirical agent evaluation, and reusable CI/CD with supply-chain security from day one. Every project shows the same posture — boring, reliable engines behind hard API contracts, strict quality gates, and explicit governance over what agents may and may not do.

bullets: Designed contract-first pipeline engines with typed (Pydantic v2) models as the sole public API and gate validators that halt on schema failure.
Authored Architecture Decision Record (ADR) cultures from the first commit; established traceable rationale chains and stable contract registries that avoid breaking renames for downstream consumers.
Separated data-plane engines from orchestration control-planes via explicit two-surface designs with zero hard orchestrator dependencies.
Designed a multi-layer authority chain to prevent policy/mechanism/state duplication across a large multi-repo ecosystem.
Applied SHA-pinned GitHub Actions across every workflow, weekly Dependabot, and CodeQL SAST as the default starting posture, not a retrofit.
Built and published reusable composite GitHub Actions (e.g. SBOM generation) with change-gated PR creation.
Configured multi-workflow quality gates combining ruff, strict type-checking, complexity ceilings, coverage floors, markdownlint, and link validation — mirrored locally via a single make target.
Migrated static JSON schemas to typed models as a single source of truth while preserving the public API across dozens of call sites, with round-trip drift-detection tests.
Built a hardened outbound HTTP layer with an egress allowlist (HTTPS-only, port 443) that raises before any socket opens, plus Retry-After-aware exponential backoff.
Implemented atomic file writes (tempfile + os.replace) with mock-injected failure tests, and a three-tier anti-bot fetch fallback behind a single typed callable.
Conducted independent benchmarking of a context-compression tool that refuted the vendor's headline savings claim, with reproducible measurements filed upstream.
Engineered baseline-aware regression detection for an autonomous TDD loop (set-difference on pre-existing failures; auto-refresh after success) to eliminate false-positive quality-gate failures.
Built content-hash caches that short-circuit expensive model inference on unchanged inputs.

cxoAngle: Fits a fractional CTO / technical-advisor role at a pre-Series-A company where the role is still IC and governance-building: systems-level authority chains, build-vs-buy rigor, and demand-for-evidence thinking. Absent: leading people/teams, org change management, P&L.

gapNarrative: All work is solo, open-source, and outside formal employment — no production user metrics, on-call rotations, or team interactions under SLO pressure.
